facts.claim: Anatomy indexed from 'Digital Anatomy of Four Music-Marketing Machines' research report (2026-10-03); per-fact evidence tiers and sources recorded in attrs.key_facts
Genre filters, follower/listener stats, approval rates, curator quotes on what they want, genre-match sliders (SubmitHub), share-rate labels on Groover ('High' >15%, 'Very Selective' <4%)

Curator-supplied data (playlist follower counts, listener averages, genre preferences, historical approval/share rates, response times, review quality scores) is the supply-side data asset - the platform's proprietary dataset for matching and tiering
Rebuildable: Spotify playlist search + Instagram/TikTok + blog hunting builds a target list for free - this is exactly what SubmitHub's directory productizes
